short: the open-source project the JDK is built from. temurin, corretto, oracle's JDK: all builds of it.
one vendor's build of OpenJDK. same code, different support, patches and license.
an environment variable pointing at one JDK's folder. build tools and IDEs read it, your shell doesn't.
a .java file with methods and fields but no class around them. java 25.
a main that isn't static. the launcher creates the object first. java 25.
java Main.java: compiles the file in memory and runs it, no .class on disk. java 11, multi-file in 22.
the list of folders and jars the JVM searches for classes. the current directory by default.
the JDK's class file disassembler. javap -c shows the bytecode javac produced.
the major version in a .class header. java version + 44, so java 25 is 69.
java's REPL. type a snippet, see its value, no class or main needed. java 9.
the $1, $2... name jshell gives a result you didn't name.
the call stack when an exception was thrown, newest call first.
a line where the debugger pauses the program so you can look around.
java debug wire protocol. how a debugger talks to a running JVM over a socket.
since java 14, NPE messages name exactly what was null.
